description: Reads your tenant, what your key rents and its usage, and runs your reseller side (child keys with your markup, your earnings). For a new key use taifoon_register; for vault money use taifoon_vault. Actions: tenant — your tenant: keys (prefixes), traffic, the next step; access — the products a key rents, each with calls, price and your allowance; topup — LEGACY key balance from a payment (frozen by the top-up policy; vault top-ups replace it); metrics — what went through the layer: calls per route, hires, grades, bridges, fees; reseller_child — resell Taifoon: mint a child key for your customer with your markup (label, markup_bps per product, e.g. { "*": 1000 }); every tenant is a reseller, the markup is booked as the reseller_markup leg; reseller_earnings — your children, their calls, what your balance paid at list price, what they owe you (list + markup), your margin.

action.description: what to do (default tenant): tenant | access | topup | metrics | reseller_child | reseller_earnings

api_key.description: api key (actions: tenant, access, topup, reseller_child, reseller_earnings)

chain_id.description: the pay chain; absent = Base (actions: topup)

label.description: a label for the child key (your customer) (actions: reseller_child)

markup_bps.description: your markup in basis points per product id, "*" for all, e.g. { "*": 1000, "taifoon.rpc": 2500 } (actions: reseller_child)

signature.description: personal_sign of the quoted message by the wallet that sent the transfer (actions: topup)

tx.description: the hash of your transfer on that chain (actions: topup)

name: taifoon_account
title: Your account
